enemies.grid_notes: GUNNHILD THE WOLF-WIDOW (Rename Table, C-CLAN-LEAD-01). Holds the hall threshold [10,3] at elev 6, fights defensively, NEVER pursues downhill. Kingsman branch: withdraws N by the goat-track (cols 7-8) at 60% HP — she must survive to carry the KINSLAYER verse into the hills (C-CLAN-04). Outlaw branch: flips to scripted ally at the order and holds the track open. Either way the player cannot fell her; her face — half Aldís's — is the map's last argument.

Night-fighter in the east longhouse's shadow (elev 4, beside the rowan knoll at [8,5], a 1h step up); strikes from house-shadow and withdraws — Ulfheim doctrine, the skirmish screen. Outlaw branch: flips scripted ally at detachment_resolves, like all Ulfheim units e2-e7.
First blade the advance meets, on the switchback road beside the byre wall (elev 2); young, loud, terrified. Ally on the outlaw flip.
Counter-attacks at the field walls from the cot-house yard (elev 2); buys the households their first two turns. Ally on the outlaw flip.

Ulfheim's bow on the crag ledge west of the goat-track notch [7,0]-[8,0] (notch elev 7), his ledge at elev 8: covers the track the whole battle. The fire never reaches him (bare rock); the player must — via the switchback top at [5,0] (elev 7, 1h up from the road at [5,1]) or the notch itself (7 -> 8, one 1h step). Ally on the outlaw flip.

Holds the spine choke on the road ramp at the middle-terrace lip ([5,6], elev 3 — the ONLY 1h step from terrace 2 to terrace 4 west of the goat-track); the road he defends is also the road the fire wants. Ally on the outlaw flip.
Gunnhild's hearth-guard on the upper yard (elev 6), her dead husband's sworn man. Outlaw secondary asks that he still stands at battle's end. Ally on the outlaw flip.

ROYAL DETACHMENT. The king's captain at the head of the line on the sledge-road (unnamed hird officer — deliberately a function, not a person: the order matters, not the mouth). Gives the turn-3 order. Kingsman: scripted ally, leads the torching. Outlaw: flips hostile-aggressive at detachment_resolves, priority target.
ROYAL DETACHMENT. Hird shield-man on the sledge-road line. Ally (kingsman) / flips hostile (outlaw) per the route trigger.

ROYAL DETACHMENT. Hird spearman; carries the torch bundle — downing HIM early on the outlaw branch delays the fire seeds by one turn (hidden interaction, rewarded in the post-battle card). Flips hostile on the outlaw branch.

ROYAL DETACHMENT. Hird bow on the in-field flank (elev 1) over the east torch seed [12,9]; on kingsman he shoots fleeing routers unless the player bodily blocks his lanes — the crown's mercilessness made mechanical, and the player's quiet counter-play. Flips hostile on the outlaw branch.

ROYAL DETACHMENT. Detachment healer at the rear, with the sledges; on outlaw the second-hardest thing to kill morally and the easiest mechanically. Cries grið when e8 falls (C-ALIGN-05) — the outlaw branch's own mercy test. Flips hostile on the outlaw branch.

ROYAL DETACHMENT. The RECORDING SKALD — the crown's official memory, beside the healer at the rear (non-combatant). Kingsman: never fights, observes, exits S at battle end — his verse is scene ch1-s11's spine. Outlaw: flees S at the flip; if he ESCAPES the S edge, the crown's Ch2 hunt begins with facts; if stopped, with rumor. The witness mechanic given a face and a wage.

neutrals.grid_notes: Household 1: mother and bundled children abstracted as one unit; slowest, starts in the west cot-house (elev 2), nearest the fire seeds. Longest run on the map: west along the field walls to the road ramp [5,6], up the switchback to the middle terrace, east to the goat-track ramp [7,3]-[8,3], and out the notch [7,0]-[8,0] — every leg a 1h step (C-ELEV-02).

Household 2: the well-keeper and his blind father, in the well yard (elev 4). Moves at the blind man's pace; paths [6,4] -> [7,4] -> [7,3] -> [7,2] -> [7,1] -> [7,0] — the goat-track ramp, all 1h steps.
Household 3: weaver-women of Aldís's scattered kin in the west longhouse (elev 4); one carries the loom-weights she will NOT drop — 2-move until she does (scripted at first adjacent fire tile).

Household 4: the old fletcher who taught half the steading's bows, in the smokehouse (elev 6); last to believe it is happening — does not move until fire reaches the upper terrace or a player unit reaches adjacency.

Byre cattle (one unit) behind the byre door at [3,8]. Loosing the door before the fire-line reaches it lets them stampede S down the road — a small mercy no ledger records; designer-note beat, C-TONE-04's 'weight' rendered small.

objectives.primary: Advance with the king's detachment on the steading — the order comes at turn 3 (route locks there; see route_variants).

kingsman.primary: Carry out the king's test: put the hearth-hall to the torch and fell or rout every Ulfheim fighter (e2-e7; Gunnhild withdraws scripted).
secondary: Accept any grið cried by Ulfheim fighters — mercy given under the recording skald's eyes is mercy the crown must acknowledge (C-ALIGN-05).
All four households (n1-n4) reach the goat-track: the order was a razing, not a slaughter — whether it STAYS one is the player's hands.
Do not loot the grave_goods in the hearth-hall (True Ledger; the relics of kin you are burning).

outlaw.primary: Turn on the royal detachment: fell or rout the king's men (e8-e13).
secondary: The recording skald (e13) does not escape the S edge — or does: letting the crown's memory live is a choice with a Ch2 price either way.
Gunnhild's hearth-guard (e7) still stands at battle's end.
Accept the læknir's grið (e12) when the captain falls.

triggers.note: e8 gives the order: 'Fire the walls. Begin with the hall.' Full-stop choice prompt — OBEY (route=kingsman) or TURN (route=outlaw). Irreversible, saves locked (C-ROUTE-01/02). Until this trigger, no unit of either side may be attacked by the player — enforced peace, so the choice is made cold.

Until this event NO FIRE EXISTS anywhere on the map — the row-9 seeds sit cold (type flammable) through the quiet pre-order phase. kingsman: e8-e12 activate as scripted allies and IGNITE all three fire seeds ([3,9],[8,9],[12,9]); e13 observes. outlaw: e8-e12 flip hostile-aggressive, e13 flees S, Ulfheim units e2-e7 become scripted allies, Gunnhild's withdrawal is cancelled, and only the seed nearest the thrown torches ([3,9]) ignites anyway — some of it burns no matter what you chose; that is the point.

Register change, read at battle start: if Grím accepted Gunnhild's fire and meal in ch1-s09, every bark, order text, and Gunnhild line on this map shifts to the guest-cup-betrayal register — the burning is oath-breach on top of kin-blood. No mechanical change; the words get worse.

Recurring, live only after detachment_resolves ignites the seeds — no fire exists before the order: fire spreads each tick from burning tiles, preferring the HIGHEST adjacent flammable tile — the terrace-by-terrace countdown (row-9 seeds -> lowest terrace elev 2 -> middle 4 -> upper 6 -> the hall). Households re-path as tiles close; the goat-track brush at [7,2]-[7,3] can burn the exit shut.

Kingsman branch only: Gunnhild goes N from [10,3] by the goat-track notch with any adjacent kin, looking back exactly once. She must survive (KINSLAYER verse carrier, C-CLAN-04); the trigger guarantees it against even a determined player. Handler no-ops unless route=kingsman — the DSL has no conjunction; the gate lives in the event handler.
Counter maintenance: post-battle script sets the counter to the number of households (n1-n4) that exited the N goat-track. Read by ch1-s11/s12 and Ch2 on both routes.

Outlaw branch: with the captain down, e12 drops her satchel and cries grið. The night's last mercy question, asked amid your own treason (C-ALIGN-05). Handler no-ops unless route=outlaw — the DSL has no conjunction; the gate lives in the event handler.

Outlaw branch only (handler no-ops on kingsman, where e13 never flees): the crown's memory reaches the south road — Ch2's hunt begins with facts. [11,12] is his own rear tile on the S edge, so the handler additionally requires e13 to be in post-flip flee mode before counting it — his scripted pre-order stand must not consume the once. [10,12] and [12,12] below are alternates on the same flight line (if he is shoved or bodily blocked); the three share the event and only the first to fire counts.

Over a burning steading the valkyrie light and the fire-glow are indistinguishable. Art direction is REQUIRED to make them so (C-LIE-01: the last night the Lie is beautiful).

designer_notes.height_gimmick: Fire climbs FROM BELOW: burning tiles spread preferentially to the HIGHEST adjacent flammable tile, so once the order lights the seeds the burn eats the steading bottom-up, terrace by terrace (row-9 seeds -> lowest terrace elev 2 -> middle 4 -> upper 6 -> the hall), and height above the fire-line IS time remaining — the inverse of ch1-02, where smoke kills the high ground first. The terrain enforces the countdown: above the lowest terrace exactly two 1h ascents exist — the road and the goat-track — everything else is wall (C-ELEV-02). The col-5 switchback road carries ramp tiles [5,6]=3 and [5,4]=5, so only the road climbs 2 -> 4 -> 6 in 1h steps, topping out at the crag shoulder [5,0]=7; the N goat-track carries its own ramp [7,3]-[8,3]=5 up from the middle terrace and the notch [7,0]-[8,0]=7 over the elev-8 crag. Every off-ramp terrace lip is a 2h wall, and the crag flanks (cols 0-1, 14-15) are sheer. Player, households, and fire all want the same two ascents; that contention is the map.
designer_notes.witness_setup: Two kinds of witness, one per route's conscience: Ulfheim's non-combatant households (n1-n4) flee for the N goat-track and can be let out, herded out, or cut off (the track brush at [7,2]-[7,3] can burn shut; e5's bow and e11's lanes both cover the runners) — and the royal detachment carries its own RECORDING SKALD (e13), the crown's official memory. On the kingsman branch the king's verse gets carved regardless (the skald cannot be silenced by his own side); the only question is whether any Ulfheim voice survives to counter-sing it. On the outlaw branch the inversion: e13 becomes the witness the player may need to stop at the S edge — kill the king's memory and the crown knows only that its detachment never came home (C-ALIGN-03/04 at full pressure). (Accounting rule: on the kingsman branch e13's survival forces the battle Sung — the crown's own record counts as witness; on outlaw the standard rule applies and e13 is the escapable witness.)
designer_notes.intent: THE SPLIT (Balmamusa pattern, C-ROUTE-02). One map, two objective sets via route_variants: the king's test is to raze his mother's kin with his own hand. Turn 3 the order comes and the choice locks route forever. Until then both forces advance together and the map is deliberately quiet — hearth-smoke, dogs barking, snow starting to glow orange at the south field walls. Levels 4-6, the chapter's hardest fight on either branch.
